payload.name: pc-check-tcp-port-list
payload.description: Pure-logic validation of a TCP-port list. Accepts a nonempty list of exact integers, each in 1..65535 inclusive, and returns {valid: boolean, ports: original list if valid else []}. Booleans are invalid; missing, null, scalar, empty, and out-of-range values fail closed by returning valid=false with ports=[] (no exception). No imports, I/O, host calls, or UUIDs. Target input contract: ports is a required nonempty list of integers in 1..65535; the runtime supplies the raw candidate through the step-local input mapping via inputs.get("ports") (not inputs["ports"]), so a missing key yields None and is invalid rather than raising. Missing/null/scalar/empty/bool/out-of-range inputs stop before any effect and yield valid=false. Result contract: {valid: boolean, ports: original list if valid else []}. Missing typed-runner prerequisite: the target inputs["ports"] mapping and Monty typed-input validation must be implemented before this component executes; typed data stays separate from assembled source.
